Focused gix-pack bounded delta-base inventory: selected output entry writer/source paths plus count_and_entries traversal target; upstream data::output::count_and_entries::traversals passed 1/1 focused test with 80 filtered out; native bounded base-candidate, existing-pack output-entry reuse, and legacy REF_DELTA recompression behavior are mapped. nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native PHP gitoxide slices cover loose objects, commits/tags/trees, refs and transactions, pack/index/object database, protocol fetch/push, transports, partial/sparse clone, recursive tree/blob merges, credential helper context/cascade/program behavior, thin-pack external-base repair, bounded pack delta-base windows, and existing-pack output-entry reuse. The latest slice maps gix-pack output boundaries for repacking existing pack entries: whole entries reuse compressed payloads, OFS_DELTA payloads are reused with rewritten base distances when their base is selected, explicit thin transit packs can reuse omitted-base OFS_DELTA payloads as REF_DELTA entries, resting packs recompress omitted-base deltas as whole objects, and legacy source REF_DELTA entries are decoded and emitted as complete whole-object entries even when their base is selected or thin output is allowed.

wordpressScenario: Git-backed WordPress content workflows, package installs, Playground snapshots, and server-side repo primitives. Current examples cover deploy-tree inspection, ref parsing/classification, protocol fetch/push flows, pack/object database traversal, partial clone/promisor hydration, sparse checkout, recursive tree/blob merges, index/worktree conflict materialization, transport boundaries, annotated release-tag provenance, credential helper context/cascade/program preflight, credential prompt fallback, thin WordPress content-pack repair using an existing base blob without invoking git index-pack, bounded delta-base search for large WordPress export packs that should avoid spending work on old bases when recent scratch blobs do not help, and existing-pack repacks that copy compressed WordPress export objects, emit explicit thin transit packs when a receiver already has the base object, or normalize legacy in-pack REF_DELTA export packs into complete resting packs.
